var epsilon = 0.001;

var allHeights = feps.concat(wugs).concat(lorches);

var bgCounts = levels.map(l => allHeights.filter(h => h === l).length + epsilon);
var bgTotal = bgCounts.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
var bgProbs = bgCounts.map(c => c / bgTotal);

function literalListenerTallness(level, threshold) {
  return level > threshold ? 1 : 0;
}

function degreeOfTallness(creature, populationBg) {
  var claim;

  var speakerModel = function() {
    var threshold = uniformDraw(thresholds);
    var level = uniformDraw(levels);
    var evidence = 0;
    if (claim === 0) {
      evidence += Math.exp(utility * Math.log(literalListenerTallness(level, threshold)));
    } else {
      evidence += Math.exp(utility * Math.log(1 - literalListenerTallness(level, threshold)));
    }
    return evidence;
  };

  function listenerModel() {
    return {
      evidence: claim === 0 ? 1 : 1/levels.length,
      dist: Infer({method: 'SMC'}, function() {
        var t = uniformDraw(thresholds);
        var l = uniformDraw(levels);
        addEvidence(claim === 0 ? 0 : 1, Math.log(literalListenerTallness(l, t)));
        return l;
      })
    };
  }

  var levelDist = Infer({method: 'SMC'}, function() {
    var threshold = uniformDraw(thresholds);
    var level = uniformDraw(levels);
    addEvidence(claim, Math.log(literalListenerTallness(level, threshold)));
    return level;
  });

  var posterior = Infer({method: 'SMC'}, function() {
    var threshold = uniformDraw(thresholds);
    return speakerModel();
  });

  var probTall = Infer({method: 'SMC'}, function() {
    var threshold = uniformDraw(thresholds);
    var level = uniformDraw(levels);
    addEvidence(claim, Math.exp(utility * Math.log(literalListenerTallness(level, threshold))));
    return level;
  });

  var probNothing = Infer({method: 'SMC'}, function() {
    var threshold = uniformDraw(thresholds);
    var level = uniformDraw(levels);
    addEvidence(claim, Math.exp(utility * Math.log(1 - literalListenerTallness(level, threshold))));
    return level;
  });

  var prob = Infer({method: 'MCMC'}, function() {
    var roundedProbs = Math.round(probTall) / Math.round(probTall + probNothing);
    factor(Math.abs(Math.log(probTall) - Math.log(probNothing)));
    return claim;
  });

  return claim;
}
